home.heroTitle: Turning complex challenges into decisions that create impact.
home.heroSubtitle: Since 2000, PRESTIGE has supported public and private actors in their strategic, economic, environmental and territorial projects.

home.introTitle: Multidisciplinary expertise serving the projects that shape territories.
home.introBody: Consulting, studies, training, monitoring and technical control: PRESTIGE brings together eight complementary areas of expertise to support clients from project design through implementation.

home.projectsBody: Since 2000, PRESTIGE has carried out missions for public institutions, international donors and private operators across West Africa.

home.geomaticsBody: GIS, digital mapping, remote sensing and drone photogrammetry: PRESTIGE deploys leading geomatics tools to inform territorial, environmental and infrastructure projects.

about.title: PRESTIGE SAU
about.subtitle: A consulting, studies and engineering firm founded in Dakar in 2000.
about.timeline2000Body: PRESTIGE SAU is founded in Dakar as a consulting, studies, training, monitoring and technical control firm.
about.timelineTodayBody: The firm has developed multidisciplinary expertise across eight areas of intervention, serving public institutions, international donors and private operators across West Africa.
about.approachBody: PRESTIGE brings together expertise in environment, economics, monitoring & evaluation, urban planning, decentralization, works engineering, water and sanitation, and geomatics — enabling a comprehensive, coherent reading of the projects entrusted to it.
about.countriesBody: PRESTIGE's missions cover Senegal and several countries across West and Northwest Africa.
